verdict.rationale: The release notes show ongoing releases: new harness support (Devin CLI, Hermes Agent, Grok Build, an Antigravity manifest) and bug fixes such as worktree removal no longer destroying untracked files and plan-scoped workspaces. A community comment independently mentions a recent update that changed self-review behavior. Nothing in the pack speaks to issue triage or accepted community contributions, so only the 'recent releases' part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of issue triage/responsiveness, evidence of merged community pull requests or external contributors, release dates/cadence.
